availableReferences.content: Owner supplied hardware photograph. No scale, manufacturer part number or approved machining dimensions. Phase 3F geometry explicitly uses provisional dimensions.

conflicts: Historical Phase 3F documentation calls its Optima sash 60 mm; the brochure identifies the illustrated Optima casement series as 50 mm. Preserve the existing models and resolve the intended series before claiming dimensional conformity.
requiredDocuments: Approved mapping of all catalogue IDs to Prominance Optima/Inventa or Uniframe product series and profile part numbers
Uniframe Aluminium dimensioned frame, sash, interlock, mullion, glazing bead and gasket sections
Touch Lock manufacturer part number, dimensioned assembly, mortise, fastener and keeper installation drawings
Casement and Tilt & Turn hardware schedules, hinge offsets, load limits, restrictors and permitted opening travel
Sliding track, roller, anti-lift and interlock details including sash overlap and travel stops
Slide & Fold hinge/roller/carriage/pivot drawings, folding sequence, track alignment and finite clearance limits
Per-design glazing stacks, bead selections, glass thicknesses, seals and DGU spacer dimensions
Approved design dimensions and installation, drainage, reinforcement and wind-load requirements
previewLimitations: Procedural profile sections, dimensions and hardware are provisional visual demonstrations. The preserved double-casement is integrated with its existing recovery contract. No design is manufacturing verified.
